paragraphs: I'm Mehul Patel, a DevOps and Cloud expert with over 12 years of hands-on experience in cutting-edge technologies like AWS, Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible, Jenkins, and Terraform. Sharing knowledge is my driving force.
Through my initiative CloudCaptain, I've conducted over 500 sessions across 25+ countries, helping individuals and organizations excel in DevOps and cloud technologies.

I actively organize events and build communities at CNCF Gandhinagar, HashiCorp Gandhinagar, and GDG Cloud Gandhinagar. Currently based in Berlin, I'm focused on AI-powered DevOps, self-healing infrastructure, and Kubernetes security.
